units.text: Aspose.OCR FOSS for .NET reads images and PDF documents and converts them into text using optical character recognition. It produces recognition results that include full text and line-level details, supporting multiple input types through the Aspose.OCR.OcrInput class. The product exposes its functionality through the Aspose.OCR.AsposeOcr.Recognize method, returning Aspose.OCR.OcrOutput for multi-page inputs or Aspose.OCR.RecognitionResult for single-page inputs. It runs on multiple .NET platforms including .NET Standard and recent .NET versions.

It performs local OCR using embedded ONNX detection and refinement models, runs entirely on the local CPU without network services or external model files, and returns one RecognitionResult per image or PDF page through the AsposeOcr.Recognize method.

It accepts input through Aspose.OCR.InputType.SingleImage for single raster images and InputType.PDF for multi-page documents, supports adding multiple files to one OcrInput container while preserving their order, and processes each page in source order.

It returns line-level results with System.Drawing.Rectangle coordinates through RecognitionResult.RecognitionLinesResult, provides individual line text via LinesResult.TextInLine, and exposes each line's bounding box through LinesResult.Line.
It recognizes Latin-script text including diacritical characters included in the embedded recognition model and returns the complete page text through RecognitionResult.RecognitionText.
It targets netstandard2.0, net8.0, net9.0, net10.0, and net48, enabling use across multiple .NET implementations and runtime versions.

Aspose.OCR FOSS for .NET exposes the AsposeOcr class as its main entry point for performing OCR operations. It produces OcrOutput collections that contain RecognitionResult objects for each processed image or PDF page.
The AsposeOcr class provides the Recognize method that accepts an OcrInput container and returns an OcrOutput collection containing one RecognitionResult per source image or PDF page.

The OcrInput class is initialized with an InputType to specify whether sources are single images or PDF documents, supports adding file paths via the Add method, and clears its contents when disposed.

Each RecognitionResult provides RecognitionText for full recognized content and RecognitionLinesResult for ordered line-level text and rectangle coordinates, where each LinesResult exposes TextInLine and Line properties.
